## Specification

### Component: Billing toggle

A monthly ↔ yearly segmented switch with a savings badge, and a price whose digits roll to the new value.
Two exports: `BillingToggle` (the switch) and `BillingPrice` (the rolling price). They share no state: the
app holds the cycle and passes the right amount to each price.

#### Anatomy
- `BillingToggle` is a `SegmentedControl` (see toggle-group) with class `ui-billing-toggle`:
  `<div class="ui-seg ui-billing-toggle" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Billing period">`
  - `<span class="ui-seg-pill" aria-hidden="true">` — the gliding highlight.
  - `<button role="radio" class="ui-seg-item ui-billing-toggle-item" aria-checked>Monthly</button>`
  - `<button role="radio" class="ui-seg-item ui-billing-toggle-item" aria-checked>Yearly <span class="ui-badge ui-badge-success ui-badge-sm ui-billing-toggle-save">Save 20%</span></button>`
- `BillingPrice`: `<span class="ui-billing-price [ui-billing-price-sm|-lg]" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">`
  - `<span class="ui-number ui-billing-price-amount">` — `AnimatedNumber` (sr text + aria-hidden digit reels).
  - `<span class="ui-billing-price-period">/ month</span>` when `period` is given.

#### Props
- `BillingToggle`: `value` / `defaultValue` (`'monthly' | 'yearly'`, default `monthly`) / `onValueChange`;
  `savings` (ReactNode, badge in the yearly option; omitted = no badge); `monthlyLabel` / `yearlyLabel`
  (default "Monthly" / "Yearly"); plus every `SegmentedControl` prop: `size` (`sm | md | lg`), `fullWidth`,
  `disabled`, `name`. `aria-label` defaults to "Billing period" unless `aria-labelledby` is given.
- `BillingPrice`: `amount` (number); `currency` (default `USD`); `locale` (default `en-US`); `format`
  (Intl options merged over `{ style: 'currency', currency, min/max fraction digits }`); `period`;
  `size` (`sm` 24px · `md` 34px · `lg` 40px amount); `announce` (default `true`).
- Whole amounts format with 0 decimals, any other amount with exactly 2.

#### Visual rules
- The control is the segmented control: muted well (`--ui-surface-muted`), 3px padding, `--radius-lg`,
  raised pill with `--ui-shadow-sm` + 1px `--ui-border-subtle` ring. Item gap 8px for the badge.
- Badge: success tint 10% (14% with a 32% border when yearly is checked) and `--ui-success-text`, 20px tall,
  pulled 4px towards the item edge (`margin-inline-end: -0.25rem`), tabular numbers.
- Price: amount 600 weight, line-height 1, letter-spacing −0.02em, tabular numbers (from AnimatedNumber);
  period `--ui-muted-foreground`, 14px/400 (15px for `lg`), 6px gap, baseline aligned, no wrapping.

#### Motion
- Pill glides on `--ui-spring-morph` (550ms) between options; no animation on first render.
- Each changed digit's reel slides on `--ui-spring-morph`; new cells (e.g. a fourth digit) rise in with
  `ui-number-in` (0.3em, 2px blur, `--ui-duration`, `--ui-ease-out`).
- Pressing an option scales its badge to .96 on `--ui-spring-snappy`.
- Reduced motion: the global rule makes every transition instant; state still changes.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA radio group: one tab stop on the checked radio; ←/→/↑/↓ move and select; Home/End jump.
- The badge text is part of the yearly radio's name ("Yearly Save 20%").
- `BillingPrice` is a polite, atomic live region; the visible digits are aria-hidden and one plain text node
  ("$24") is read. When several prices change together, set `announce={false}` on them.

#### Acceptance checks
- Clicking Yearly checks it, the pill rests on it, and the price text becomes the yearly amount.
- Arrow keys switch the cycle; focus follows; only one item has `tabindex="0"`.
- `.ui-billing-price` has `aria-live="polite"`; its sr text matches the formatted amount.
- The price's width does not jump while digits roll (tabular figures, fixed cells).
- Works in light and dark and with every `data-accent`; axe finds no serious violations.

### `ui/components/billing-toggle/billing-price.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { AnimatedNumber } from '../animated-counter/animated-counter';

export type BillingPriceSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export interface BillingPriceProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, 'children'> {
  /** The price to show. Changing it rolls each changed digit to its new value. */
  amount: number;
  /** ISO 4217 currency code. Default `USD`. */
  currency?: string;
  /** BCP 47 locale. Default `en-US` (fixed, so server and client render the same). */
  locale?: string;
  /** Extra Intl.NumberFormat options, merged over the currency defaults. */
  format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions;
  /** Muted text after the amount, e.g. "/ month". */
  period?: ReactNode;
  /** Amount size: 24 / 34 / 40px. Default `md`. */
  size?: BillingPriceSize;
  /**
   * Announce changes politely to screen readers (`aria-live="polite"`). Default `true`.
   * Turn it off when several prices change at once and one summary is announced elsewhere.
   */
  announce?: boolean;
}

/**
 * BillingPrice — a price whose digits roll to the new value (AnimatedNumber on the morph spring)
 * with a muted period after it. Whole amounts show no decimals; others show two.
 * Screen readers get the plain formatted text, announced politely when it changes.
 */
export const BillingPrice = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, BillingPriceProps>(function BillingPrice(
  { amount, currency = 'USD', locale = 'en-US', format, period, size = 'md', announce = true, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const fractionDigits = Number.isInteger(amount) ? 0 : 2;
  const options: Intl.NumberFormatOptions = {
    style: 'currency',
    currency,
    minimumFractionDigits: fractionDigits,
    maximumFractionDigits: fractionDigits,
    ...format,
  };
  return (
    <span
      ref={ref}
      className={cn('ui-billing-price', size !== 'md' && `ui-billing-price-${size}`, className)}
      aria-live={announce ? 'polite' : undefined}
      aria-atomic={announce ? true : undefined}
      {...props}
    >
      <AnimatedNumber className="ui-billing-price-amount" value={amount} format={options} locale={locale} />
      {period !== undefined && period !== null && period !== false && period !== '' && (
        <span className="ui-billing-price-period">{period}</span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/billing-toggle/billing-toggle.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { badgeClassName } from '../badge/badge';
import { SegmentedControl, SegmentedControlItem, type SegmentedControlProps } from '../toggle-group/segmented-control';

export type BillingCycle = 'monthly' | 'yearly';

export interface BillingToggleProps
  extends Omit<SegmentedControlProps, 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'onValueChange' | 'children'> {
  /** Controlled billing cycle. */
  value?: BillingCycle;
  /** Initial cycle when uncontrolled. Default `monthly`. */
  defaultValue?: BillingCycle;
  onValueChange?: (value: BillingCycle) => void;
  /** Label of the monthly option. Default "Monthly". */
  monthlyLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Label of the yearly option. Default "Yearly". */
  yearlyLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Badge inside the yearly option, e.g. "Save 20%". Omit for none. Part of the option's accessible name. */
  savings?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * BillingToggle — a two-option segmented control for monthly ↔ yearly pricing, with an optional
 * savings badge on the yearly option. The highlight pill glides on the morph spring; arrow keys
 * move and select (radiogroup). Pair it with <BillingPrice> so prices roll to their new value.
 */
export const BillingToggle = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, BillingToggleProps>(function BillingToggle(
  {
    value,
    defaultValue = 'monthly',
    onValueChange,
    monthlyLabel = 'Monthly',
    yearlyLabel = 'Yearly',
    savings,
    className,
    'aria-label': ariaLabel,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const hasSavings = savings !== undefined && savings !== null && savings !== false && savings !== '';
  return (
    <SegmentedControl
      ref={ref}
      value={value}
      defaultValue={defaultValue}
      onValueChange={onValueChange as ((value: string) => void) | undefined}
      aria-label={ariaLabel ?? (props['aria-labelledby'] ? undefined : 'Billing period')}
      className={cn('ui-billing-toggle', className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <SegmentedControlItem value="monthly" className="ui-billing-toggle-item">
        {monthlyLabel}
      </SegmentedControlItem>
      <SegmentedControlItem value="yearly" className="ui-billing-toggle-item">
        {yearlyLabel}
        {/* A real space, so the accessible name reads "Yearly Save 20%" (collapsed visually by flex) */}
        {hasSavings && ' '}
        {hasSavings && (
          <span className={badgeClassName({ variant: 'success', size: 'sm', className: 'ui-billing-toggle-save' })}>
            {savings}
          </span>
        )}
      </SegmentedControlItem>
    </SegmentedControl>
  );
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

/* Billing toggle ----------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-seg ui-billing-toggle" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Billing period">
     .ui-seg-pill + .ui-seg-item.ui-billing-toggle-item × 2
       yearly item may hold <span class="ui-badge ui-badge-success ui-badge-sm ui-billing-toggle-save">

   <span class="ui-billing-price [ui-billing-price-sm|-lg]" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
     <span class="ui-number ui-billing-price-amount">…rolling digits…</span>
     <span class="ui-billing-price-period">/ month</span>
   Digits roll on the morph spring (animated-counter.css); reduced motion swaps instantly.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-seg-item.ui-billing-toggle-item { gap: 0.5rem; }

  /* The savings badge reads as part of the yearly label; it stays tinted in both states */
  .ui-billing-toggle-save {
    margin-inline-end: -0.25rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-billing-toggle-item[aria-checked="true"] .ui-billing-toggle-save {
    --ui-badge-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-badge-tone) 14%, transparent);
    --ui-badge-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-badge-tone) 32%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-billing-toggle-item:active:not(:disabled) .ui-billing-toggle-save { transform: scale(0.96); }

  /* Price */
  .ui-billing-price {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-billing-price-amount {
    font-size: var(--text-4xl);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  .ui-billing-price-sm .ui-billing-price-amount { font-size: var(--text-2xl); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .ui-billing-price-lg .ui-billing-price-amount { font-size: var(--text-5xl); }
  .ui-billing-price-period {
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .ui-billing-price-lg .ui-billing-price-period { font-size: var(--text-md); }
}

## Usage

**Billing toggle** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/billing-toggle/basic.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { BillingPrice, BillingToggle, type BillingCycle } from '@/ui/components/billing-toggle';

export default function BillingToggleBasic() {
  const [cycle, setCycle] = useState<BillingCycle>('monthly');
  const yearly = cycle === 'yearly';

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-5">
      <BillingToggle value={cycle} onValueChange={setCycle} savings="Save 20%" />
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
        <BillingPrice amount={yearly ? 24 : 30} period="/ month" size="lg" />
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{yearly ? 'Billed $288 once a year' : 'Billed monthly, cancel anytime'}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
